warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3 at 3.00 + 3.00 (6.00); y = A-B-C-D-E at 3.00 + 3.00 + 3.00 + 1.50 (10.50). Origin A1. Same main chains on A-03, S-01 (both views), S-02, S-03 and the elevations/sections. Vector CAD PDF; marks read from the text layer, dimension values read off the rendered page.

x dummy 1'' (2.00) and y dummy B' (4.50) come from the 2.00 + 1.00 and 1.50 + 1.50 chains of S-01/A-03 and carry real beams. 1'/3'/A'/E' (roof eaves 1.00 outside the grid), 2' (4.50, Truss T4) and D' (10.00, left-wing eave, chain 1.00 + 0.50 between D and E) come from the S-03 / A-03 roof-plan chains (section 4 rule 4).

C' (7.50) is NOT printed: it is the node where the hip rafter from C2 meets the T4 ridge, measured by proportion against the S-03 grid (beam-endpoint rule, section 4 span amendment); confidence 0.6, scaled_from_grid. The S-03 plan draws the Truss T2 ridge about 0.25 above row E, but no dummy is made for it: the T2 elevation (S-04) spans 3.00 between two อะเส posts and T4 spans 4.50 from T2 to T1 (= E to C), so T2 sits on row E (E2-E3) — see the roof_frame_plan file.

z: the two upper levels are both printed 'ระดับหลังอกไก่' (+4.11 and +4.81); ids carry the value to keep them distinct. Room-tag floor levels (+0.00 / +0.18 / +0.31) from A-03 are recorded as named levels.
